## Create Testing File

```{r}
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)
```

```{r}
if  (!file.exists("small-restaurant-visits-209874.csv")) {
  fn <- "restaurant-visits-209874.csv"

  # read the first 10 rows of the csv into a data frame
  some_lines <- read.csv(fn, nrows = 10)

  # create a smaller version of the csv for testing
  write.csv(some_lines, "small-restaurant-visits-209874.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Data Exploration
```{r}
df <- read.csv("small-restaurant-visits-209874.csv")
str(df)
```
```{r}
conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "restaurants-db-02102026.sqlitedb")
dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
dbListFields(conn, "restaurants")
dbReadTable(conn, "restaurants")
```

```{r}
dbReadTable(conn, "servers")
```


```{sql connection = conn}
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='servers';
```


```{sql connection = conn}
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'restaurants';
```

```{sql connection = dbcon}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS raw_csv_data;
```

```{sql connection = dbcon}
CREATE TABLE raw_csv_data (
    RestaurantID            INT,
    ServerEmpID             INT,
    ServerName              VARCHAR(100),
    VisitDate               DATE,
    VisitTime               TIME,
    MealType                VARCHAR(20),
    PartySize               INT,
    WaitTime                INT,
    CustomerName            VARCHAR(100),
    CustomerPhone           VARCHAR(20),
    CustomerEmail           VARCHAR(255),
    LoyaltyMember           BOOLEAN,
    FoodBill                DECIMAL(10,2),
    TipAmount               DECIMAL(10,2),
    FoodDiscountPercentage  DECIMAL(4,2),
    PaymentMethod           VARCHAR(30),
    orderedAlcohol          VARCHAR(3),
    AlcoholBill             DECIMAL(10,2)
);
```

```{r}
df.full <- read.csv("restaurant-visits-209874.csv")
```


```{r}
dbWriteTable(dbcon, "raw_csv_data", df.full, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
``` 


```{r}
dbDisconnect(conn)
```
